properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 14 at 1:39PM MDT until August 14 at 4:45PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northwestern Elbert County in east central Colorado...
Northeastern Douglas County in northeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 445 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Rises in small streams and normally dry creeks.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 139 PM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges
indicated heavy rain due to thunderstorms. This may cause urban
and small stream flooding. Between 0.5 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen.

- This includes the following streams and drainages...
Gold Creek, Newlin Gulch, Piney Creek, Dry Creek, Running Creek,
Willow Creek, Cherry Creek, Coal Creek, Bayou Gulch, East Plum
Creek, Happy Canyon Creek, Lake Gulch, East Cherry Creek, Kinney
Creek and Kiowa Creek. Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch
are expected over the area. This additional rain will result in
minor flooding.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Eastern Castle Rock, Parker, Elizabeth, The Pinery, Franktown,
Ponderosa Park, Castle Pines and Castlewood Canyon.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 14 at 1:36PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 135 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm over
Cokedale, or 7 miles west of Trinidad, moving northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph, brief pea size hail and torrential
rainfall.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Quick runoff will cause ponding of water
on roadways and quick rises in creeks, streams and normally
dry washes.

Locations impacted include...
Trinidad, Cokedale, Starkville, and Boncarbo.

properties.description:

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around

Locations impacted include...
Castle Rock, southwestern Parker, The Pinery, Franktown,

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 14 at 12:59PM MDT until August 14 at 4:00PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
FFWPUB

The National Weather Service in Pueblo has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Middle Aspen Acres Burn Scar in...
East Central Custer County in southeastern Colorado...
West Central Pueblo County in southeastern Colorado...

* Until 400 PM MDT.

* At 1259 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Middle Aspen Acres Burn Scar. Between 0.2 and
0.5 inches of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 0.5
to 1 inch in 1 hour. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly. Excessive rainfall over the burn scar will result in
debris flow moving through Middle Creek, and North Creek Drainages.
The debris flow can consist of rock, mud, vegetation and other
loose materials.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Middle Aspen Acres Burn
Scar.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Middle Aspen Acres Burn Scar.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
San Isabel, Highway 165, Beulah, Highway 78, stream crossings, and
county roads within and immediately downstream of the burn scar.
